_how_to_use: Prompt = style + scene text + end. Paste character strings VERBATIM every time a character appears; never paraphrase them. The Figma image tool takes no reference images, so identical wording is what keeps characters consistent. Add a new era outfit for Indio per episode with indio_era_template and save it under indio_outfits.
style: Modern Japanese TV anime: crisp clean line art, cel shading with two-tone shadows, vivid saturated colour, painted skies with light rays, dynamic low-angle composition. Scene:
end: Vertical 9:16. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
no_text_clause: Any papers, signs and plaques show only illegible scribbled lines, never readable letters.

rules: Indio's constants in every era: red headband, bronze medallion, tattoos (one more after each jump: episode N starts with N-1 tattoos).
In modern-day scenes the headband is absent. Usman NEVER appears in modern-day scenes: he exists only inside a time jump (user, 2026-11-12).
Real historical people are drawn as generic anime figures described by clothes and build, never as likenesses.
No Christian cross/church unless the scene really is one; say 'no cross, no church, no religious statue' for civic monuments.
